title: Efficacy and Safety of Long Term Use of hCG or hCG Plus hMG in Males With Isolated Hypogonadotropic Hypogonadism (IHH)
brief_summary: This study will evaluate the efficacy and safety of long term use of hCG alone or hCG plus hMG in the treatment of male patients with isolated hypogonadotropic hypogonadism (IHH). One third of the participants will receive hCG treatment alone and the other third of the participants will receive hCG treatment alone for six months, then the hMG will be added. And the last third of the participants will receive hCG and hMG treatment since the beginning of the treatment.
